import type { FileUploadContract, FileRecord } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface FileUploadProps extends FileUploadContract {
    variant?: 'button' | 'dropzone';
    description?: string;
}
/** Explicit submit helpers append the committed set, never the ephemeral chooser list. */
export declare function appendCommittedFiles(data: FormData, name: string, files: readonly FileRecord[], disabled?: boolean): FormData;
export declare function FileUpload(props: FileUploadProps): import("solid-js").JSX.Element;
